description: This file defines a React functional component 'BackupsDropZone' that handles file drag-and-drop, specifically for decrypting backup files. It manages state for the dropped file, decrypted content, and binary file selection, utilizing hooks such as useState, useEffect, useCallback, and useMemo. The component offers user interface controls for selecting related files, triggering decryption, and displaying status messages.

methods.name: chooseRelatedBinaryFile
methods.description: Handles user action to select a binary file using the application's file selector, setting the binaryFile state if successful.

methods.name: downloadBinaryFileAsDecrypted
methods.description: Decrypts the selected backup and saves it locally, updating UI and alerting the user based on success or failure.

methods.name: handleDrop
methods.description: Handles file drop events, verifying file type and parsing JSON metadata to initialize the decryption process.
